entries.zh: 接后手；居间接手贿赂、事后分润赃私
entries.en: to take over a bribe as go-between; to handle the 'backhand' share of a bribe (cohecho: bribery)
entries.notes: H 首字'排/接'存疑，据 M'siap'、R'jie' 定读'接'；'后手'取居间分润义。

entries.zh: 赂脱；花钱贿赂以求脱身、赎脱
entries.en: to bribe one's way out; to pay for one's release (cohechar por librarse)

entries.zh: 塞口；用钱封人之口、使其缄默
entries.en: to stop someone's mouth with a bribe; to buy silence

entries.zh: 贴先生分；给先生（书办）贴份子、打点书吏
entries.en: to bribe the scribes/notaries, tipping them a share; 'and to the party' (tail garbled)
entries.notes: 西语尾句 'iv a la parte -' 潦草，疑为 'y a la parte'（并及当事人），展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 得后手；收受背后转手的赃私分润
entries.en: to take a cut of a bribe behind the scenes; to receive the passed-on 'backhand' (cohecharse)
entries.notes: 西语 'llebar ake chu' 潦草难确读，据 H/M/R'得后手'定释。

entries.zh: 受人买嘱；受钱受人嘱托办事（受贿嘱托）
entries.en: to accept a bribed commission; to be paid to do another's bidding
entries.notes: L 尾部标 [残] 截断（疑为 llevar cohecho 之类），按规程降为低置信；H/M/R 三栏完整互证'受人买嘱'，释义本身较可靠。

entries.zh: 得财卖放；收了钱财私自放走（人犯）
entries.en: to take money and covertly release (prisoners) for gain
entries.notes: 西语 'changfona' 潦草未能确读；据 H/M/R'得财卖放'（明清刑名语：受贿放走人犯）定释。

entries.zh: 炮；火炮火铳，兼指炮仗、烟火

entries.notes: 西语词头 'Cohers' 疑为 'Cohetes' 截笔/误读，展开依赖推断；据 H/M/R'烟火'定释。

entries.zh: 炮仔药；爆竹火药，鸣炮庆贺所用
entries.en: firecracker powder; fireworks for celebratory salvoes

entries.zh: 鸟鼠炮；会窜会响的花炮（如鼠窜地、追人脚跟）
entries.en: 'bird-and-rat' firecrackers — crackers that scurry along the ground chasing one's feet with loud bangs

entries.zh: 某种瓜菜名称，H 第二字'邊/漢'存疑；西语自注更正语未能确读，所指未能定夺
entries.en: a gourd/vegetable name, referent uncertain; the Spanish self-corrects ('digo cà na horia'), not resolvable
entries.notes: H 第二字'邊/漢'存疑、M/R 音读与两候选字均难对上，西语自改语 'cà na horia' 未能确读，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 紧紧搂抱、捏紧；一把攥住
entries.en: to clasp/seize him tightly; to squeeze hard
entries.notes: H 字'搿/揑'与 M 音'Pè/Què'存疑，据西语 apretadam.te＝apretadamente（紧紧地）取紧搂紧攥义。

entries.zh: 成群捉拿；如捕蝇般大批拘捕
entries.en: to catch by the swarm, like flies; to seize en masse
entries.notes: M/R 栏字迹潦草且句末截断，H'拼/拚'存疑，仅据西语 'como moscas' 与 H 取'成群捕捉'义。
仅 M 栏拼写 'quíp/quip' 存疑，音义一致，不影响释义。

entries.zh: 摘；拈取（西语谓如鹤啄衔而取）
entries.en: to pluck, to pick up (as a crane snatches)
